title: Stamp dependency fields with a file override over ecosystem defaults

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Prepare the pending API minor release locally. Our npm manifests must use exact (=) internal dependency ranges, but packages/ui/constraints.json is a deployment manifest and needs tilde (~) internal ranges instead. Configure the ecosystem default and a typed versioned_files override on ui, naming only dependencies in that override. The deployment file's own version and external-lib dependency must stay as they are. Do not publish, tag, or push.
expectation: Group manifests become 2.4.0 with ui's internal dependency =2.4.0; the additional deployment dependency becomes ~2.4.0 while its version stays 2.3.1 and external-lib stays ^9.0.0.

checks.why: Preparation must stamp all group manifests.
Typed file prefixes must beat ecosystem defaults without stamping undeclared fields.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
